signal: Balto is a finalist for Cloud-Based CX Solution of the Year at the 2026 CCW Excellence Awards and is sponsoring CCW Vegas, pushing its real-time contact-center AI

email.body1:
Dan, saw Balto is a 2026 CCW finalist and headed to Vegas pushing its real-time guidance AI.

Momentum and a big event usually open more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Balto off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Balto.

With CCW driving a wave of interest, pipeline targets climb faster than headcount can cover the inbound and outbound at once. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Balto needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Balto.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Balto's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and conference season is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Balto either way.
